verdict.rationale: Chroma Cloud is documented as a managed, serverless offering with usage-based charges. One explicit per-unit price is shown ($0.03 per fork, paying only for incremental storage), and new users get $5 of free credits. Community users confirm there is no node sizing or sharding to provision, praise the transparent pricing calculator, and note scale-to-zero tiers. Missing for 10: explicit per-unit rates for core storage, writes and queries in the evidence, and independent detail on how the usage billing works in practice.
